extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (api.tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - A title that cannot load now tells you why. Where the page used to come up empty -- no artwork, no synopsis, and a Play button with nothing on it -- it now says whether your server could not be reached, your profile needs unlocking again, or the title is no longer in your library, and offers a Retry button. - Stray marks at the edge of the screen are gone. If you had made the interface smaller (Settings > Interface > Skin > Zoom, below 100%), two things appeared outside the picture: a small pale tick to the left of the player's progress bar, and a sliver of the next card past the right-hand end of the rows on Home and Discover. Both sat just off the edge of the screen, where a reduced zoom brought them back into view. Nothing about these screens has changed at 100%.

extension.news: - The next episode keeps your audio language. Starting the next episode from the Up Next rail could put it on the soundtrack the file itself lists first, rather than the language on your profile -- a series whose files carry German before English would come back in German at every episode. tofa now checks which track is really playing before deciding there is nothing to change, and checks once more a moment later that the language it asked for is the one you are hearing.

extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (api.tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Long titles are no longer cut off on the home screen and the details page. Where something has no logo artwork of its own, tofa shows its name as text -- and that text was set so large that a long name ran most of the way across the screen and was still cut short. It is smaller now and wraps onto a second line, so you get the whole name. - tofa asks once more to add its fonts to your skin, because the change above needed a text size it had not installed before. It is the same one-off question as always and Kodi restarts straight after; nothing else changes. - Subtitles that sit in separate files beside a film now play properly. Where a film's subtitles are in a pair of files next to it rather than inside it, tofa used to either re-encode the whole picture to paint them on -- costing quality -- or not offer them at all. They are now sent across as they are and drawn on top, so the picture is untouched. Needs tofa server 0.9.32. - Video your server has to convert on the way to you can now arrive as HEVC instead of H.264, which holds more detail at the same bandwidth. tofa had never said it could take anything but H.264, so it always got the older one. This applies only to conversion -- anything that plays untouched is unaffected -- and only once whoever runs your server has switched HEVC on for it, which is off to begin with. - This version needs tofa server 0.9.32 or newer. On an older server the sidecar subtitles above will not appear and converted video keeps coming as H.264; everything else works as before.

extension.summary: Install and update the tofa add-on
extension.description: The update channel for tofa's Kodi add-on. Installing this repository lets Kodi fetch the add-on and every later release on its own.
